method: Release frameworks supplied by caller. Metal required. Alternating process order. Each process discards three warmups and takes medians of 15 fresh documents. XML is in memory; bitmap allocation and clearing are outside timers. Total is parse plus first draw. Redraw uses each instance after its first draw. Initial per-process timings are recorded separately, not guaranteed cold startup. Summary reports medians of process medians.
memoryMethod: Separate fresh processes after all timing runs. One small SVG warms common runtime state. Source and bitmap allocated before baseline. Physical footprint sampled after parse and first render with temporary autoreleases drained and the SVG retained. Peak RSS covers the whole process; deltas include allocator and rendering caches.
baselineNote: Baseline Release binary has the committed behavior. It predates the comment wording cleanup, which changed no executable behavior.
change: Replace the parser reference map for its own XML document with a lazily allocated array indexed by XML node position. Retain reference objects in slots and release slots after parsing. Preserve the map fallback for other documents and allocation failure.
decision: Retained. Pcolormesh 2 parse median improves from 90.12 to 84.43 ms. First draw is effectively unchanged. Other fixtures also improve in parsing.

validation.pixels: exact first and warm pixels in all paired runs
